workflow.acceptance_note: Implementation and runtime evidence are recorded; canonical workflow acceptance remains owner-controlled and no successor stage was activated.

root_cause.evidence: Production runtime logs showed GET /api/clients returning 304 while the client contract could parse an empty 304 body as null.
root_cause.cause: Workspace-scoped GET requests were allowed to participate in browser/intermediary HTTP caching even though the application already has scoped in-memory GET deduplication.
root_cause.risk: Stale or empty responses after auth/workspace changes, with shared HTTP cache behavior unsuitable for workspace-scoped data.

changed_paths.change: Workspace-scoped GET requests now use fetch cache mode no-store.
Client API responses now send an explicit private no-store Cache-Control policy.
Regression guard covers both client fetch policy and API response header.
